meta.name: tfx-persist
meta.description: DEPRECATED — tfx-auto 로 통합됨. `/tfx-auto --retry ralph` 로 리다이렉트. Phase 3 부터 true ralph state machine (unlimited, stuck detector 3회 중단, state file 복원) 이 동작한다. Phase 5 (v11) 에 물리 삭제 예정.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重定向旧命令至 tfx-auto 新命令
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你还在用旧命令,想自动转成新版
copy.tagline_en: Redirect the deprecated command to tfx-auto
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you still use the old command and want it to auto-forward to the new one

howto.what: 装上后，当你说出“持续做到完”之类的指令时，Claude 会先把任务转交给新的 tfx-auto 技能，并以无限重试模式执行：反复尝试直到任务成功，若同一错误连续出现 3 次才停下。过程中会记录一条弃用日志。
howto.when: 当你说出“ralph”、“don't stop”、“끝까지”等表示“不要停、坚持到底”的触发词时触发。

say.note: Claude 会持续尝试直到报告完成。

say.text: 不要停，继续修复所有测试失败。
say.note: 它会在失败后重试，最多连续失败三次。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you tell Claude to keep going, it hands off to the new tfx-auto skill with unlimited retries: it retries until success or 3 consecutive failures, and logs a deprecation note.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'ralph', 'don't stop', '끝까지', etc., meaning 'keep going until done'.

say_en.text: ralph, finish the report before resting.
say_en.note: Claude will keep trying until it's done.

say_en.text: Don't stop; keep fixing all test failures.
say_en.note: It retries after failures, up to 3 consecutive.
